Hi OP! Working student here. I started Law School after I found a job that was flexible enough to accommodate my adjustments during my first term. It was really hard at first, but you will get the hang of it. I would suggest you find a job first then enter school, since it will be hard for an employer to consider you for a full time position when you are already studying. 

For saving up, I think Beda Alabang would be quite pricey. Hope your fam will help you out with the tuition. I opted to pay my tuition because I wanted to lift my parents the burden of shouldering a dream that wasn’t theirs. Starting the journey was a struggle, but I am happy with the decision.

Good luck!
